fee_notes: Standard 20-year Unit Franchise Fee is $40,000 for new franchisees. Non-Traditional Unit (10-year term): $15,000 if located within a Host Facility; $30,000 for stand-alone "Perkins Griddle and Go" location. Existing franchisee in good standing discount: $30,000 for traditional Unit; $13,500 for Non-Traditional Unit with Host Facility; $20,000 for stand-alone "Perkins Griddle & Go". Veterans (Patriot Program): 25% reduction on single-unit Franchise Agreement for New Development Units only (applies to first unit only). During most recent fiscal year (May 1, 2024 – April 29, 2025), some transactions had the Initial Franchise Fee reduced to fees ranging from $20,000 up to the standard fees. Transfer fee for resale units may vary; one transfer in the most recent fiscal year had a transfer fee of $15,000. The entire Initial Franchise Fee is payable when the Franchise Agreement is signed. Partially refundable (50% less Perkins' costs) only if Perkins terminates the agreement due to failure to complete initial training.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for a twenty-year Standard Unit Franchise (the " Initial Franchise Fee ") is $40,000 for a new franchisee, unless either (a) you qualify for the veteran's discount under Perkins' current Patriot Program, which is described below in this Item 5 under the heading "Incentive Programs," or (b) you are an existing franchisee purchasing an additional unit, as described below. For a Non-Traditional Unit, the Initial Franchise for a ten-year term is $15,000 if the Unit will be located within a Host Facility, and $30,000 if the Unit will be at a stand-alone, "Perkins Griddle and Go" location.
